entities.name: Ashoka the Great
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maurya Emperor of India (c. 304–232 BCE) who converted to Buddhism after the bloody Kalinga War. His reign spread Buddhist values across South and Southeast Asia through rock edicts promoting dharma, non-violence, and religious tolerance.
